The caps disagree. execution-core accepts OFFICE_PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES up to 8 MiB (parse_preview_max clamps to MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES), but the gateway drops any PDF above 2,796,204 base64 characters (2 MiB).
